title: hOla Verde
team: Andrea Cutroni, Carlos Román, Claudia Serment
description: Sustainable design strategies for a timber office building in Málaga — natural ventilation, shading and a platform-frame structure in natural materials.
body: hOla Verde develops sustainable design strategies for an office building in Málaga, prioritizing natural ventilation, shading systems and a green roof. Sun-path studies across summer and winter days informed the shading and massing strategy.
The structure uses a timber platform-frame system with cork insulation and bamboo and recycled-material plaster for interior finishes, designed in AutoCAD, Revit and Twinmotion.
